name: Qwen-Image 2.1
description: Qwen-Image 2.1 makes an image from a prompt. To edit from reference images, use qwen_image_21_edit.

requirements.notes: Graph follows ComfyUI's own template image_qwen_image_2_1_t2i, and needs ComfyUI v0.37.0 or later (TextEncodeQwenImage21, QwenImage21Cache). Default files are Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1's int8 builds: the 7B transformer qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot (7.26 GB), the Qwen3-VL 8B encoder qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot (9.35 GB) and the VAE (0.68 GB). The same repo ships a smaller encoder, qwen3vl_8b_w4a8 (6.31 GB), for machines short on system RAM; pass it as clip. The weights and encoder together exceed an 8 GB card. TESTED 2026-09-22 on a 12 GB RTX 4070 Ti with the default int8 files: 1024x1024 at 25 steps took 72 s, of which sampling was 17 s (about 0.7 s/step). The rest of the run is loading the weights and running the 8B encoder. The prompt's quoted sign text came out spelled exactly. License: Qwen Research License, non-commercial use only (huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1).

prompt.description: Describe the picture. Put any text that should appear in the image in quotes.

negative_prompt.description: Only read when cfg is above 1.

width.description: Multiples of 32. Qwen's listed sizes run from 2048x2048 at 1:1 to 2752x1536 at 16:9.

steps.description: ComfyUI's template runs 25; Qwen's own examples run 40.

cfg.description: Keep at 1 for the official path. Raise it only to use a negative prompt.

examples.prompt: A hand-painted wooden sign on a market stall that reads "FRESH FIGS 3 FOR $2" in chalky white letters, crates of figs below it, early morning side light, shallow depth of field.
